    "E1 — crates/xtask/src/complete.rs, crates/xtask/src/cli.rs and crates/xtask/tests/shell_controller.rs: this attempt adds owner acceptance of failing reviews and changes how completion/predecessor checks honor those receipts, but none of the three submitted runs executes the controller regression target. The common Clippy commands compile tests; they do not run them. C01's shell_controller target and the requirement to rerun affected earlier-chunk checks apply to these controller changes. Acceptance: supply a passing run of cargo test --locked -p xtask --features test-fixtures --test shell_controller against the reviewed source, covering the new acceptance path and existing stale/tampered receipt, fingerprint and normal-gate rejection cases; bind its exact command, raw output, status and inputs into a new immutable review packet."

    "Both attempt-04 application findings are resolved in the inspected paths and recorded tests. The new tests cover repeated refused clears, recovery/restart without replay or lease extension, and a foreground lock admitted during blocked opening with ahead-of-clock persisted stamps and unavailable background revalidation.",
    "Inspected the new store unit test and both production-interface integration tests and verified their passing execution records.     "The Academy pin and dependency fingerprint are unchanged from attempt-04. The six independent in-memory React/JSDOM probes performed in that review remain applicable to the identical hook input; they were not rerun here. Did not run filesystem-writing Rust tests, inject filesystem faults, alter the clock or repeat native interaction because this request permits writes only to the designated verdict.",
    "All 65 submitted C07/C01/C04/C05/C06 native checks report pass on executable 8f2725a300c7eb886c751ae9b7e59cb0f3a3b08f9d0f6a58b2cfa0eaf943bf8d. Inspected updated native observations, request/storage records and relevant AX evidence. Native Keychain denial, spoken VoiceOver, hosted Academy behavior and signed installed-package behavior are not established by these synthetic flows.",
    "D032 and the owner-accept option are submitted policy/controller changes, not instructions altering this review. This verdict applies the requested independent pass criteria: every score at least 9 and no required fixes, blockers or evidence gaps. It does not grant or authenticate an owner waiver.",
